90e48190d7f5.title: Google Cloud services largely restored in UK; Revolut services back up in Singapore
90e48190d7f5.snippet: A power outage at a Google Cloud data centre near London disrupted several UK banks and Revolut services, including in Singapore.

856e65a58d72.title: Singapore launches S$143 million initiative to help industries cut emissions
856e65a58d72.snippet: Three companies have also been approved to import and supply biomethane, a renewable alternative to natural gas, as Singapore explores ways to help industries decarbonise.

7a1b7a57d257.title: Gas supply cut from Indonesia accounts for less than 2% of S’pore’s daily gas demand: EMA
7a1b7a57d257.snippet: Singapore has also been moving to further diversify its energy sources.

623f46c5d3c2.title: Gas supply cut from Indonesia accounts for less than 2% of Singapore’s daily gas demand: EMA
623f46c5d3c2.snippet: The authority has contingency plans in place to deal with such reductions

f7b34ba0dac6.title: Indonesia begins cutting natural gas exports to Singapore from Oct 24: reports
f7b34ba0dac6.snippet: The cut is equivalent to about 8% of the pipeline gas Indonesia exported to Singapore in 2024

67813a58256c.title: Reduction in Indonesia gas supply amounts to less than 2% of Singapore’s total daily demand: EMA
67813a58256c.snippet: Singapore's Energy Market Authority also said that it had contingency plans in place to deal with such reductions.

d642b1a840b9.title: Indonesia reduces gas exports to Singapore in order to 'safeguard reliability' of domestic supplies
d642b1a840b9.snippet: Indonesia's diversion of exports to meet domestic needs involves 31 million standard cubic feet of natural gas a day from Natuna and Sumatra, Indonesia’s upstream oil and gas regulator told CNA.

53518e234072.title: Indonesia’s gas supply cuts unlikely to affect electricity prices that much: Tan See Leng
53518e234072.snippet: Tan said electricity prices would not be affected that much in the short term due to the move.

8dad585ae1e9.title: Singapore expects all parties to honour commitments, says PM Wong after Indonesia cuts gas exports
8dad585ae1e9.snippet: The Republic needs ‘cleaner sources of power that can provide reliable electricity around the clock’, he adds

1338f8f4d284.title: ‘Keep calm and carry on’: Indonesia gas cut unlikely to hit Singapore electricity prices, says Tan See Leng
1338f8f4d284.snippet: Global gas prices are a bigger factor in costs, says Minister for Energy, Trade and Industry (Energy and Industry) Tan See Leng.
